card.name: Last digits of large counts
card.fires_on: The final digit group or the word 'million' completing a large number, often after 'more than', 'over' or 'about', before the thing being counted.

modes.label: Final zero of a thousands figure
modes.description: The last '0' of a number like 20,000 or 100,000 right before the counted noun.
modes.example: which features more than 20,00<<0>> agricultural antiques.

modes.label: The word million
modes.description: 'million' after a digit, giving a count of people or visits.
modes.example: With more than 6<< million>> visits annually

card.writes: It weakly suggests a continued count in English, while suppressing Chinese and English words for hundreds or several hundreds.
card.plain: It marks the end of a big number, such as 20,000 or 6 million, just before the thing being counted.
